title: Interactive Scatter Analysis
text:
This notebook creates interactive 3D and 2D scatter plots.


Code
import plotly.express as px
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

np.random.seed(42)
df2 = pd.DataFrame({
    'x': np.random.randn(200),
    'y': np.random.randn(200),
    'z': np.random.randn(200),
    'category': np.random.choice(['A','B','C'], size=200)
})

fig = px.scatter_3d(
    df2, x='x', y='y', z='z',
    color='category',
    title='Interactive 3D Scatter by Category'
)
fig.show()




Code
fig2 = px.scatter(
    df2, x='x', y='y', marginal_x='histogram', marginal_y='box',
    title='Scatter with Marginal Distributions'
)
fig2.show()

title: Time Series Analysis
text:
This notebook demonstrates time-series decomposition.


Code
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from statsmodels.tsa.seasonal import seasonal_decompose

df = pd.read_csv('data/sample.csv', parse_dates=['date'], index_col='date')

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
df['value'].plot(ax=ax, title='Monthly Values')
ax.set_ylabel('Value')
plt.show()

result = seasonal_decompose(df['value'], model='additive', period=3)
fig = result.plot()
fig.suptitle('Additive Decomposition', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()




Code
df['rolling_mean'] = df['value'].rolling(window=2).mean()
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
df[['value', 'rolling_mean']].plot(ax=ax, title='Value vs. 2-Month Rolling Mean')
ax.set_ylabel('Value')
plt.show()
